translation:
Husked Barley (穬麥)

Husked barley: use it by pounding it; that grown in autumn is the best, while spring-grown has insufficient qi. Therefore, using it with small wheat and sand-stone seeds lightens the body, greatly supplements, removes heat, and relieves restlessness. It unblocks the large intestine; according to the Classic, when cooked it is not irritating.

Therefore husked barley is a type of large barley; both have outer husks. Like one grain of rice split into two — husked barley's skin is the covering. In small nomenclature it is called husked large barley; in large nomenclature it is husked barley, which is a rice-like grain.

Although husked barley is said to be large barley, its skin is hard and crisp. Large barley is suitable for pairing with rice and wheat; compared with them, husked barley and small barley in large nomenclature are both called husked barley, which is a grain like rice.

Grain Category — Wheat

Large Barley Noodles

It benefits people; if eaten in excess it causes qi to rise, leads to abdominal distension and fullness, helps digestion of retained food, removes qi downward from the stomach, opens the stomach, and stops sudden turmoil (cholera-like illness). It cannot be used in all cases.

Its nature is slightly slow and warming; its flavor is sweet and salty, non-toxic. It can digest retained food, relieve abdominal distension and fullness, move qi downward, open the stomach, and stop sudden turmoil. Do not use it indiscriminately.

Green Grain Category — Wheat

Large Barley Noodles

It benefits people; if eaten in small amounts it can draw out and relieve distress. Barley when made into cakes stops thirst, but moving qi — if eaten suddenly in large amounts it seems to stir and overwhelm.

Barley: although its color is said to be yellow, it is suitable for the stomach; heavenly-raw skin swells, and if eaten hot it seems to stir and overwhelm the qi.

Barley Malt (大麥蘗)

It benefits people; if eaten in excess, retained food is removed, abdominal distension and fullness are relieved, qi is moved downward from the stomach, the stomach is opened, sudden turmoil is stopped. Do not use indiscriminately.

It can be used to promote birth; the sprout becomes the malt. Large barley is soaked in water until the sprout appears; eating too much suddenly — dry it before use, it cannot be used wet.

It can be made into a drink to tonify; the sprout can promote delivery of the fetus. Large barley is soaked in water; do not eat too much of the stomach portion; if dried suddenly it cannot be used.

It benefits the middle, aids digestion, and is used medicinally. When used as medicine, stir-fry until yellow, break into fine pieces, dry by roasting, and use for intestinal gurgling.

translation:
Buckwheat (蕎麥)
Its nature is neutral, flavor sweet, non-toxic. It strengthens the intestines and stomach, boosts qi and strength, though it may aggravate various illnesses. Should not be eaten together with pork or lamb. It refines the five grains, moistens and nourishes the essence and spirit. Caution: prolonged consumption may stir up wind and cause dizziness in people.

Noodles (麵)
[Made from buckwheat.] Can treat intestinal and stomach ailments; may be boiled and eaten. Folk saying: eating this grain will dispel and clear [digestive troubles]. It benefits the ears and eyes, settles the qi.

Leaves (葉)
The juice is used to wash [affected areas]. Burned to ash, the smoke and ash are used medicinally.

Stalks (稭)
[The lye water] strained from burning the stalks is used to treat sudden turmoil disorder (霍亂). Its nature is slightly warm, benefits the sinews and bones.

Hyacinth Bean / Lablab Bean (稭豆)
There are two varieties, black and white. The white variety moves qi downward and harmonizes the center; the black variety has similar properties. Both are sweet in flavor and non-toxic. Also known by the herb name Wood Crane Bean (木鶴豆). The white variety resolves [toxins]; remove the skin, mix with fresh ginger juice, and stir-fry. This is the same as White Flat Bean (白扁豆).

Leaves (葉)
Treats sudden turmoil disorder (霍亂) with vomiting and diarrhea. Should not be eaten carelessly.

Flowers (花)
Treats red and white vaginal discharge (赤白帶下).

Seeds (子)
[Properties described above apply.]

translation:
Mung Bean (菉豆)

Nature: neutral (평성). Flavor: sweet, non-toxic. Main uses: benefits qi, eliminates dampness, resolves toxins. Take the beans and soak in water.

Powder (粉)

Use with the skin on. Cook until done. Removes skin color — if small and round, that is best quality. It is said: must resolve toxins before eating; the flavor is sweet, non-toxic; benefits qi and eliminates dampness.

Removes skin — the skin is cold in nature, the flesh is neutral. Brightens the eyes and treats:
- Head wind, headache, the twelve meridians
- If swelling occurs, this must be used as a good medicine; do not use the pillow [of skin]
- Removes illness — do not remove the skin; cover with skin — cover with skin

Removes toxins of cinnabar (dan), heat, wind rashes. Calms the spirit and moves through the twelve meridians. If swelling develops, this should be a good medicine. Do not remove the skin; keep the skin — skin is cold, flesh is neutral.

Mung Bean (號豆)

Also called: Mung Bean (菉豆); also called Xian Jing Bean (咸鏡豆). Color is green. It is said it also grows in the fields. Flavor is sweet; has some toxicity. Main use: dries the lungs, transforms lung qi, stops vomiting.

Yi Yi Ren (薏苡仁) [Job's tears seed]

Now when blood comes out, biting and gnawing [pain], nature is slightly cold. Main use: wind-dampness. It is also said it grows in the fields and has some toxicity. Main use: dries dampness, leg qi (beriberi), trembling. Transforms lung qi, stops vomiting.

When used at midday, grind it and administer — then you get the kernel. For those of robust constitution who have taken medicines for a long time, it causes the person to eat with diminishing strength; gradually the strength softens and harmonizes.

It lightens the body. Used in diet to attack stagnant qi. For true persons of robust constitution, this can gradually soften the strength — one must [use it carefully].

translation:
Lin Wan (Forest Pill): Used to prepare iron-ground grain. The longest grain rice variety, also large, with many grains. It is planted in this region.
Chengzi Rice (Steelyard-seed Rice): Used to make cooked rice; the qi is pungent, the flavor is crisp. It can be used by the southern peoples as a mortuary offering.
Miaozi Chestnut (Small-seed Chestnut): It is taken with food, and is then absorbed into the body through the digestive tract. It nourishes over the years. Its flavor is crisp. According to Korean sources, it is used without toxicity. The flavor is sweet, non-toxic, and treats counterflow in the stomach and vomiting of water. Red and white varieties exist, with four leaves or thousands of them.
Regarding the leaves: they are extremely fine and astringent, white in color, and plentiful. Their nature is to lean on the rice. The flavor is sweet, non-toxic, and treats counterflow in the stomach.
On processing: Stir-fry with vinegar and honey in water. Use the astringent quality. Take once daily. Slowly, with heat. It has pores. Poppy (Afu-rong) is used to fill the intestines, stop sinew-membrane issues, and intestinal deficiency, chronic fatigue, and fragmentation.
Shell pieces (Poppy capsule): Ground and used with bamboo. Once activated, it absorbs the name Afu-rong (opium poppy). Yellow, filling the intestines, stopping sinew-membrane issues, intestinal deficiency, chronic fatigue.
Opium (Ya-pian): Immediately carved with a knife and ground in a mortar at the proper time. Used in a pot, strained through a sieve ten-fold. Once heated, it has pores. Afu-rong (poppy) fills the intestines and stops sinew-membrane and intestinal deficiency conditions, and chronic fatigue.
Outer and inner flower parts are carved. After three to five days of emptying the core, the paper seal is applied. Do not take with alcohol. After two days the physician should review; after seven days the physician's recommendation is bamboo flower preparation.
Garlic water the size of a bean, taken once daily, dissolved in water with bamboo. Scraped with a large scraper in a brass instrument and opened, then formed and immediately used as medicine.

translation:
Alcohol (Wine/Spirits)

General properties: It is greatly hot in nature, bitter in taste, sweet on the skin, with toxic properties. It mainly promotes the circulation of medicinal potency, kills all evil toxins. Long-term consumption damages the spirit and shortens one's lifespan. When drunk, it dispels cold, and it is especially suitable for the saying "wine brightens the mind." Its nature is uniformly acrid and hot, therefore its nature is to generate prolonged warmth.

Among all substances, drinking too much damages a person's longevity. Among all flavored drinks, those that are sweet and enduring, if one does not stop, interact similarly to the effect of aconite — the flavor is acrid, it contains toxicity, and because its nature is hot, it uniformly acts as one flavor.

It alone can move downward to the extreme and disperse throughout. According to the Bencao (Materia Medica), it is said that when extremely intoxicated and thereafter it can dispel cold, though toxicity is not mentioned; then it can move and scatter with its acrid properties.

Moistening the body: According to the Bencao, it is said that when greatly intoxicated the fire rises; when greatly drunk, if one uses it to make vinegar and fermented preparations — various qu (yeast cakes) of wheat, opened and then applied to the yeast base afterward.

Grain-lees wine (Zao xia jiu): Its nature is mild, pressed from the dregs along with medicine — treats wind-cold. Called qu-wine, must use qu starter. Among all things made, proper fermentation is the correct method.

Soybean-strained wine (Dou lin jiu): Treats opisthotonus (backward arching spasm due to wind), assists with releasing the arc-bow tension, dispels wind-cold.

Green onion and fermented soybean wine (Cong chi jiu): Harmonizes and resolves wind-cold, promotes dispersion and induces sweating.

Grape wine (Pútáo jiǔ): Benefits the kidneys, preserves the complexion and maintains a youthful appearance.

Nature: Cold. Flavor: Bitter (some say salty). Treats: Fevers with headache, chills and heat, miasmic diseases. Also induces sweating.

Soybean Paste (Jang/Doenjang):

Vinegar (Cho):
Nature: Warm. Flavor: Sour. Non-toxic. Mainly disperses blood stagnation, breaks up blood blockages, stops pain in the heart and abdomen, and resolves hard accumulations.

Maltose (Yitang):
Made from the five grains. Also called: stops dryness. Nature: Warm. Flavor: Sweet. Mainly supplements deficiency, benefits qi and strength, moistens dryness. [It is] thick and rich.

[Regarding pickling and fermentation with vinegar and salt:]
Much salted and pickled food teaches people that it benefits the muscles and skin. Vinegar that has been aged two to three years is considered proper and functional. Aged vinegar of two or more years is called "xi" (醯) and is considered the genuine article.

Tofu (Bean Curd)
It is said that among strong types, the honey type enters the middle warmer and is used in decoctions; when it enters the spleen, it becomes like amber in color. The so-called "glue malt syrup" — when mulberry is added above, one can make it. Those who are elderly with softness [need] white [variety].

[Regarding tofu:] It enters [the body]; consuming too much generates heat, activating the spleen and heart. Various [materia medica] texts note that it can cause dampness to flare up in the middle.

Its nature is neutral; it is said the flavor is sweet but it has some toxicity — it can stir up qi and cause head wind, numbness, and stomach disorders. Eating too much [of it] is harmful.

Tofu: Consuming it disperses [stool]; it has toxicity. Its nature is cold; it suddenly stirs up qi. Those who are pensive — its nature is neutral; it mainly [helps] those who cannot digest food. Taking it promptly resolves [the condition]. Rolling it up is especially [effective].

Spring Pestle Head Fine Bran (Chun cheo du se gang):
Meaning: Its nature is sweet and non-toxic. The flavor among [grains] is sweetest. It governs treating deficiency of the lower digestive tract and supplements insufficiency, thickening [soups]. [In Korean medicine] eating too much is harmful for those with excess water and small [constitution].

Sou Mi (Searched/Sifted Rice):
It generates qi and is similar to various medicinals. Among them it most greatly benefits qi and supplements thickness. It is quite different in name. Scattered/Loose Hair (亂髮)

There are 39 types [of conditions treated]. The nature [of this medicine] is slightly warm, bitter in taste. It benefits water passages, stops bleeding, and treats the five types of urinary disorders.

Hair (髮髮)

[Treats] gu toxin (parasitic poison), various toxic herbs. Used warm, applied [topically]. Treats urinary blockage and inability to urinate. Treats liver conditions of horses as well. Can also be taken internally. [Treats] snail and clam [related conditions].

translation:
Dried Human Skull-Top Cloth (Skull Cap)

[On the use of human skull-top cloth:]
It transforms and acts externally. Applied [to the body], it is non-toxic. Its main action is against heart poisons. It immediately connects and binds like a cord or cloth. It also washes away [the condition]. The juice is drunk. It is the main treatment for three-year chronic headache.

Ear Wax
Its nature is warm. It is mainly used for ear epilepsy, mania, eye fright, and spirit disorders. Together with [other medicines] it treats scabies and sores that will not heal around the eyes.

Tooth Scale (Tartar)
Grind it. Its nature is balanced/neutral. It treats one type of poison. It is generated in living people's bones — that is, the tartar that falls from the teeth.

Saliva and Spittle
Take what is on the tongue. Apply it directly. It is non-toxic. It mainly treats and dissolves carbuncles, scabies, and abdominal masses. [Used on] the crown of a dead person's head [for certain conditions].

Human Skull Cap (Tianlinggai)
This is bone. Grind it. Use one that is old and deeply aged, with the decayed smell gone — such a one is excellent. The fragrant and well-decomposed brain [bone], once washed and processed with moxa or fire, has no corrosive toxicity. Otherwise it may cause death.

[Ethical warning:]
In this world, the use of such things is forbidden on moral grounds — it is not [right] medicine. Only a benevolent person with a humane heart would hesitate. The physician Sun Simiao admonished all physicians afterward [on this point].

[Further warning:]
[One] who takes this and uses it harms others in return. Instead, use tiger head bone or yellow dog head bone as substitutes — [the skull cap] is toxic.

translation:
Human Breast Milk

Human breast milk: neutral in nature, sweet in taste, non-toxic. It supplements the five viscera, peels away old skin, and moisturizes the skin.

It is used to treat red, painful eyes and wasting conditions. It is sweet in taste, non-toxic, and supplements the five viscera.

Regarding nourishing properties: it has no equal for those lacking teeth. One woman who drank it along with mare's milk, cow's milk, and human milk — after consuming it fully over many years — lived to over one hundred years of age. Ordinary milk, cow's milk, and human milk do not surpass human milk itself.

[Section on] Placenta (Pao Yi):

Also known as Ziheche (Purple River Carriage); another name is Hundun Yi (Primal Chaos Membrane). It mainly treats wasting, poor blood circulation, lower back fatigue, yang deficiency, and postpartum facial damage.

The fresh placenta is best. To prepare it: wash it thoroughly, remove membranes and vessels, clean away impurities, then place in a bamboo steamer rack.

Method of preparation: after delivery, wash the placenta, remove the membranes and blood vessels, dry it, grind it to powder, and soak with vinegar in a bamboo-slatted basket. Ancient methods from the west use vinegar-soaked bamboo basket steaming.

For a male child's placenta, use one method; for a female child's placenta, use another. The placenta is placed with nine yang herbs. The quantity and foot measurements follow the ancestral tradition.

translation:
Human Feces

When taken, it nourishes and generates vital energy. It is said to strengthen yang and help produce children. This medicine, when combined with blood-nourishing medicines, acts as a stabilizing agent. It is superior to mineral-based medicines for treating disorders of the blood.

Placenta Transformed into Water

Named after plant and wood, one method treats wind disorders and revives people. Within one or two days it greatly treats epilepsy and madness, loss of essence, and disorders of the will. This formula is a women's blood formula, and its use should avoid conflict with other medicines. The name refers to the placenta of the vehicle. After nine times nine days it suffices. This water is the water of the Gate elixir. When the placenta is buried in the ground for seven or eight years, all toxins transform into water. It primarily treats lung abscess, nourishes the lungs, clears the voice, moistens the muscles and skin, benefits the heart, and is extremely fast-acting. Take eight fen, combined with pungent fire-reducing herbs, to be taken by elderly women. It treats lung abscess and pain in ten chapters.

Human Urine

Also called Yin liquid. In men it treats coughing, bleeding, and disorders where the patient is robust but spits blood. For elderly patients who are healthy but have no other medicines to take, taken alone it reduces fire. For women of fiery constitution, it is cooling in nature and treats lung abscess and bodily ailments, and is used similarly to Renzhongbai.

Renzhongbai (White Sediment from Chamber Pots)

Also called Autumn White. It is collected, dried in frost, calcined, ground into powder, and used. It reduces fire, urgently treats conditions where the dog urinates abnormally. When taken it supplements the center. Its nature is burning, dissolves phlegm, and treats lung abscess and bodily ailments similarly to Renzhong (human center).

translation:
Autumn Stone (Qiu Shi / 秋石 — processed urine salt):
It is of Yang nature. Take by mouth. Removes fatigue, strengthens bones, nourishes essence and blood, replenishes and soothes, brightens complexion, benefits the will, and strengthens virility.

Menstrual Blood of Women (婦人月水):
Used topically. Treats poisoning. Applied to a blade it can detoxify. Methods of restoring vital energy and defending life are recorded in the Nangguk (Southern Country) formularies. Apply to the blade for convenience.

Red Lead (紅鉛 — first menstrual discharge):
Treats various conditions related to Yin. It is hot in nature. Draws out toxins. For women at the time of menstruation, the taste is salty, and it contains toxins. Collected from menstrual water. Can also be used in the same way. Supports and benefits women. Caution: do not use if there are lesions or initial ulcerations.

Undergarment of a Man (人褌襠):
Used for illness. Use the undergarment of a man. The body sounds and functions improve. Take in decoction. Detailed dietary guidance: men use it for deficiency of qi; for women it addresses weakness and toxicity. Do not use without caution. Do not exhaust the supply. Harmful to women with initial ulcerations.

Human Feces (人屎):
Preserved and collected from various sources. Toxic in nature. Extract the water and dry and steep it. It is appropriate to collect, dry and char it. The main use is high fever. Boil into a decoction. Also decoct it. Treats manic running and agitation. For urgent cases, use as an antidote.

translation:
Human Bile (人中黃) — Good Medicine

It resolves [toxins], eliminates malignant sores, fungal poisons. Its nature is [used for] heavenly seasonal febrile illnesses and related conditions.

[Method:] Take a length of green bamboo, sealed at both nodes. Insert licorice root (甘草) into the bamboo tube, submerge it [in human waste/bile material], and leave it for a period. Extract it; it is also called "Rénzhōnghuáng" (人中黃). Take it out through a drilled opening. [This is used to treat various toxic and febrile conditions.]

Human Fingernail (人爪甲)
Used whole, covering [the affected area]; removes obstructions; taken orally. Its nature is balanced. It treats difficult labor and promotes birth. [Applied or used] by the practitioner accordingly.

Navel of a Newborn Child (新生小兒臍)
Taken as a drink. It regulates the diaphragm and stomach. Its primary [action] eliminates malignant sores and promotes healing of flesh. The dried navel [collected] shortly after birth is ground to ash and used.

Elderly Person's Urine (翁部尿)
Of seven or nine kinds, one hundred [applications]. Its nature is slightly warm, flavor is sweet, non-toxic. Its primary actions: permeates and invigorates the spirit, kills toxins, wards off evil and inauspicious [conditions], stops flooding [hemorrhage].

Rooster Meat (丹雄雞肉)
Its nature is slightly warm, flavor is sweet, non-toxic. Primary actions: warms the middle, frees the spirit, kills toxins, and is suitable for those with [various conditions].

translation:
[This page from Dongui Bogam discusses the medicinal properties of various parts of the rooster (chicken). The content proceeds as follows:]

[Introductory section on chicken in general:]
The chicken belongs to the category of wind creatures and is associated with the trigram Xun (wind/wood). It is related to wood and fire. The rooster crows and is therefore associated with wind. However, because the chicken can also assist in dampness and fire diseases, one must be careful. It is said that eating chicken along with fish and similar foods can aggravate illness caused by pathogenic wind.

Head [of the rooster]:
The head is mainly used against toxins. It treats conditions of the Eastern Gate [acupuncture point], disperses white carbuncles, abscesses, sores, wind conditions, and clears the ears when wind pathogen has entered.

Cockscomb Blood of the Red Rooster:
Used together to treat carbuncles, white abscesses, pain from wind, and sinew-wind conditions.

Droppings [of the rooster]:
Used together with treatments for dispersing wind and pain; benefits urination; the nature is slightly warm; removes cinnabar toxins; the flavor is sour; treats manic-wind disorders; calms the five viscera; stops [illness].

Meat of the White Rooster:
Nature is slightly warm; removes cinnabar toxins; the flavor is sour; treats manic disorders; calms the five viscera; stops [illness].

Meat of the Black Rooster:
[Also discussed are the feet and brain of the white chicken.] Among chickens, those that are white with black eyes are especially noted. Nature is slightly warm and non-toxic. It mainly treats heart palpitations, abdominal pain, fractures and injuries, and removes carbuncles and abscesses.

[Properties:] Beneficial to qi, stops diarrhea. Not suitable for regular consumption from the ninth through the twelfth month. Nature is slightly cold; removes skin sores and rashes. Taste is sour, non-toxic, slightly cold. Primarily supplements the middle [jiao], tonifying and beneficial, though slightly toxic.

[White variant description:] There is a type with white coloring, with black markings on the back, called the White Goose; it is also of this category. One variety is called the Wild Chicken. It is not appropriate to eat from the ninth through the twelfth month. [The text notes it is commonly called Wild Chicken in certain regions, referring to it by the name found in the mountains along rivers in the south.]

translation:
Goose Head
Goose head: [Korean phonetic reading]. Nature: neutral. Flavor: salty. Non-toxic. Mainly treats wind headache, dizziness, vertigo, and epileptic conditions. Similar in appearance [to duck]. Also called "Mu." Should be used with moxibustion. Preferably use the male. The goose and duck are listed together.

Black Goose
The leaves [parts] of large and small black goose. Nature: neutral. Non-toxic. Treats coughing, bone-steaming (tuberculosis-like fever), consumptive wasting, and also acute wind conditions. Together treats coughing and bone-steaming; calcine to powder and take mixed in a drink.

Eye (of goose)
The eye: treats eye diseases; promotes blood circulation; when burned [calcined] is used medicinally.

Wing Feathers
Used to break open sores; used for relieving blood stagnation in disease; burned for use.

Steamed Goose Juice
[Phonetic reading]. Made from the goose gland. Large. The goose [product] is not [large in quantity] but small in nature. Flavor mostly sour and salty. Non-toxic. Mainly treats carbuncles, bone-steaming, and consumptive disorders; stops transformed cold-cough (kuǎn) conditions.
Those that do not fly in groups or make goose sounds — these are today called "款 (kuǎn)."

Male Goose Meat
[Moonlit evening], treats stone-dysuria; [the nature of] seeing spirit-sleep; five flavors; do not eat this at night.
Burning the male goose (heated): treats stone-dysuria and wind conditions; greatly cold; slightly acrid; non-toxic; mainly treats carbuncle and dissipates bound accumulation.
Burned and cast into stone [calcined]: disperses and resolves; this is the male; today it is said casting stone [with it] stops [conditions]; the male also stops [the condition].

The crane: the male is a green bird. It is not necessary to distinguish it finely. When burned, the one whose ash sinks in water is the male; the smaller one is the female.

Burning the feathers: acrid in flavor. Used for cuts and wounds, injuries from blades. The larger ash that sinks in water is male; the smaller is female.

Treats wind diseases. The nature is warm and balanced, flavor is sweet, non-toxic. Benefits the qi and assists the body.

In general it treats wind diseases. Resembles the crane but is smaller; black, non-toxic in color. Those with a sweet flavor and spotted markings brighten the eyes and benefit qi. Those without spots also exist.

The early crane is the small crane. Flavor is sweet, balanced, non-toxic. It mainly benefits qi. At the autumnal equinox, the spotted crane becomes the yellow crane; when the qi divides it becomes balanced.

After a long illness, eating it restores what has been depleted. Eating the yellow crane at this seasonal phase: non-toxic, mainly resolves the toxicity of various medicines and dispels [birds] that gather in the eaves of houses.

Long-term illness: the nature is balanced; consuming it leads to recovery. The flavor is sour, non-toxic. It mainly resolves the toxicity of various medicines and dispels [birds] that gather in the eaves of houses.

Adjusts the head [conditions]. Extremely ill patients: consuming it, the nature being balanced, leads to swift recovery. Flavor is sour, non-toxic. Mainly resolves the toxicity of various medicines.

One dose: adjusts toxicity; boil it. For patients who cannot bear pain, stores away without healing sores. Its call: treats malign conditions together with wind-type skin eruptions and urticaria; also resolves wind eruptions.

Name: also called quail. Like the pheasant but wild. The wild quail is the true one. Breaks up sinews and bones, disperses accumulations and nodules.

Wind type: the wild quail is the true one. Breaks up sinews and bones, disperses nodules.

Also treats childhood nutritional disorders (gan disease), dysentery with five-colored stools. Eating it is beneficial. The bones dispersed become the quail.

(From:) Dongui Bogam, Tangaek (Herbal Liquids) Section, Volume 7

translation:
Pelican (鵜鶘)
Korean reading: bi-eum. Pelican. A bird of the fields. It resembles a rat transformed. It is sweet, non-toxic, like pine resin. It expels evil and can be eaten. It is smaller than the cormorant. Soak in wine and eat.

Cormorant (鸕鷀)
Korean reading: i-eum. Cormorant. Its nature is mild, its flavor is salty. It has slight toxicity. It is the master treatment for various carbuncles, abscesses, and epilepsy. If taken together they make one love [the medicine]. Eating it is also acceptable.

Mandarin Duck (鴛鴦)
Korean reading: i-eum. Mandarin duck. It is toxic. For women who are unharmonious [in body], make a broth and eat it. Those who live near mountain streams — its form resembles a wild goose but smaller. It feeds alone. Born in mountain valleys. Keep in a cage.

Magpie (鵲)
For those living near streams with sandy soil, its form is like water. Shoot it with arrows.

Magpie Flesh (鵲肉)
Its color is abundant. Smear with mud, wrap, and roast in embers. Its cry is long like a cormorant's.

Woodpecker (呼木鳥)
This bird is used as medicine. This bird is difficult to obtain in the south. It is as large as a salt vessel, greenish-black in color. This is the bird. Above it has Korean red feathers. There are also mountain varieties. It has teeth to gnaw wood and eats wood grubs, pecking them all out. It also cures hemorrhoids.

White Crane (白鶴)
Its names are Liang-he and Zhuo. It supplements the lungs. Its nature is mild, its flavor is salty, non-toxic. It benefits the qi and strengthens. It supplements blood deficiency. The white ones are selected for use. The black, yellow, white, and grey varieties all exist. Take the white ones.

translation:
博勞 (Shrike)
Nature: neutral, non-toxic. The shrike is used mainly for children's skin diseases. The skin is non-toxic, and is used mainly for chronic red and white dysentery and infantile malnutrition (gan). Another name is 鴝鵒.

鵓鴿雀 (Pigeon-Sparrow)
Found on islands in the sea, about the size of a partridge. Nature: neutral; taste mild. Has a fat pouch that can hold about two sheng (升). The substance inside is white. Another name is 逃疳 (Escape-Gan).

巧婦鳥 (Clever Wife Bird / Wren)
Its form is small. For women who have long suffered from abdominal problems, the fat pouch beneath is effective. Take its eggs, or burn and fumigate the woman's hands [with it]. Found in nests like small pouches. Also known by another name.

鷦鷯 (Wren)
Peach-sparrow, bamboo-sparrow, green sparrow: nature warm, taste sweet, non-toxic. Living among the reeds, eating them is delicious. Various sparrows are said to be beneficial for yang and the body's vital functions. The nests are built in the form of crowns. The spirit of these birds is fierce.

鷦雉 (Small Pheasant)
No particular taste; sweet, non-toxic. Main uses: restores dead flesh, benefits people; used as food as well.

百舌鳥 (Mocking-Bird / Hundred-Tongued Bird)
For children who have long been unable to speak or are slow of speech: treats the heart-mind and the tongue. Has been recorded as a remedy.

黃褐侯 (Yellow-Brown Marquis Bird)
Said that taking it daily, placing the leg bones near the bed, causes couples to love each other. Like the 鴆 bird. Non-toxic. Processed into a green-orange colored substance.

希殺
Take it daily; the leg and intestinal bones are collected and worn on the body as a charm.

translation:
Cuckoo (杜鵑)

Cuckoo Entry:
The cuckoo is also called the "jeokdong" bird. It has another name. Among its names, it is said that the one who first hears the cuckoo's call at the start of spring is significant. It is also called by another name. Its flesh governs qi deficiency and wasting. It is an ancient bird with an ominous cry. It also catches mice. It flies at night and rests during the day. There is a creature called by one name that has horns, two eyes like a cat's, flies at night and enters human dwellings. Its kind resembles a chicken. It is rarely seen. It is not fat or beautiful. This bird is sensitive. When one encounters evil influences, it is used to ward them off. Applied to sword blades, it prevents rusting. It is a water bird.

Cuckoo Fat (鵑膏):
It is often found near the ear. It benefits the interior, nourishes the spleen, supplements the constitution. Its flavor in food is non-toxic and governs various conditions.

Egret Flesh (鷺鷥肉):
It governs accumulations and benefits the five flavors; its taste is sweet. It supplements qi and flavor. Eating it is non-toxic. Its main action is to relieve dryness and thirst.

White Egret (白鷺):
Egret gallbladder: it is able to supplement qi, dispel [pathogenic influences], its flavor in food is rich; moxa and eating it together.

Pigeon (鴿鴿):
Its flavor in food is delicious, supplements qi, benefits [the body], dispels [pathogenic qi]; eating it together with moxa [is beneficial].

Turtle Dove (鵓鴿):
Its nature is binding and warm, its quality is heavy. It governs gu-qi (parasitic) and miasmic illness. Its form resembles a hen. Its call sounds like the words "born in Yeongnam (Lingnan)."

Dragon Bone — Beast Section, [page] 96-2, 103

Flavor: sweet, non-toxic. Stops diarrhea in children. Nourishes essence and spirit, stabilizes the hun-soul. Calms the heart and mind. Treats epilepsy and seminal emission. Good quality specimens are ancient bones; those with jade-like coloring, yellow-white hue are preferred for medicine.

[Dragon bone treats] loss of blood, stabilizes the five [organs]. Its nature is balanced/neutral. Repels pathogenic qi from afar. The bones of the dragon; fine-textured bones in black color are second grade. [Processing:] grind with brine, or chop and decoct in soup; remove fat; dry and select pieces. Useful for chronic pain, epilepsy, mania, seminal emission.

Purple Twig Flower (Zǐ Shāo Huā)
Nature: warm. Flavor: sticky and clinging. Warms yang internally, stabilizes the hun-soul (prevents it from flying away), treats epilepsy; used together with dragon bone and egret [bones] for conditions involving mania and seminal emission.

Dragon Teeth (齒)
Nature: balanced. Calms fright and stabilizes the hun-soul. Calms the heart. Used to treat epilepsy, mania, and pain.

Musk (Shè Xiāng)
Color: purple-flower [colored]. Nature: warm. Flavor: acrid, bitter, non-toxic. Principal actions: repels malign qi, counteracts foul miasmas, relieves heart and abdominal pain, removes visual obstructions, resolves skin conditions, calms fright. Relieves itching of the yin [genital] region, scabies, insect toxins; difficult heart and abdominal pain; removes obstructions from the flesh and skin.

Opens the orifices, repels evil qi, disperses hidden heat, reaches the muscles and flesh, the yin interior, transforms [stagnation in] the bones and yang channels, penetrates the membranes, regulates the brain. [Its fragrance] permeates.

[Musk] taken with food resolves the hundred swellings and toxic sores, [repels] evil from the membranes. Nature warm. Penetrates the flesh and skin, transforms yang stagnation in the bones.

Ox Bezoar (Niuhuang)

[Properties and uses:] The ox bezoar is found in the liver and gallbladder of the ox. Its nature is calm; its flavor is bitter. Some sources say it has mild toxicity. It is also said that when the ox cries out and its hooves strike the ground, a bezoar may be found. The genuine article glows and has a true, solid body. Those that cause objects to glow when held up to the light and, when one bites into it and it dissolves, are the best quality. It eliminates evil influences, governs the sinews and vessels, treats epilepsy and mania, calms the spirit, and stops convulsions. It enters the liver meridian and strengthens the sinews. At times when the ox bellows and water forms on its skin and fur, one may obtain it. Those with skin and fur visible and dried in sunlight — when free of mania and seizures — are genuine. It removes evil, treats epilepsy and mania, is used to scrape the claws and massage the skin, and when the blood color returns on recovery from crying and the fragrance falls, it is the true body.

Ox Meat
Common name: also called raw huang. The liver and gallbladder flavor is sweet and non-toxic. It strengthens the sinews in people, tonifies and benefits the abdomen and legs, stops vomiting and diarrhea, and treats jaundice. It is a fine food item.

Ox Horn Scraping
The ox, being an animal, is equipped with horns. Ox milk and meat, if diseased, cannot be eaten. Black ox [preparations] strengthen and invigorate. Used for vaginal discharge, use the horn scraping: nature is bitter and sweet, non-toxic; stops uterine bleeding and both red and white [vaginal discharge].

Head and Hooves
Burn and preserve the charred nature. Treats abdominal masses, intestinal wind with diarrhea, bleeding, and uterine hemorrhage with red and white discharge.

translation:
Su (Butter/Clarified Butter)

[Section on Su:]
Su is made from milk. Its nature is slightly cold. It is produced from domestic livestock. The flavor is sweet, non-toxic, and warming. It tonifies the heart, benefits the lungs, stops thirst, and moistens the hair and skin. There are four kinds of Su: ox-milk Su is considered superior; next is sheep-milk Su.

[Section on Sing (Refined Butter/Ghee):]
Good cheese (lac) is processed to make Su. The flavor is sweet and non-toxic. It supplements deficiency, relieves coughing and pus-blood, and penetrates the skin to treat abscesses and fistulas. Refined butter in the middle grade, among all dairy products, is the finest. It penetrates deeply.

[Continuation:]
Over many years, using it for convenience: take the thickest, heaviest portion of the lac (cheese liquid), as it does not penetrate in winter, is difficult to maintain, and in summer the child portion should not be depleted. The sweetest portion of the surface is the best.

The beauty is that when the color is like oil, that is the best. According to Korean practice, when making lac, when it is heated and the heavy top layer rises, that which comes out cannot be obtained in great quantity. [Korean note on method.]

[Section on Sea Otter (Haedat):]
The sea otter: it is like a large dog with fish-eating habits. Its fur, when worn, does not allow fish or bird bones to harm the person who ingests them. [Additional Korean vernacular glosses on hardness and saltiness of the meat.]

Rhinoceros horn is used to treat evil influences, heat toxins, and blood disorders. The horn that is thin with many nodes and ridges is considered superior quality.

Do not use in battles entering the fat [tissue]; for the kidneys; for [treating] sores on the brain as well as barking [conditions].

translation:
Skin:
Treats carbuncles and boils when decocted and taken orally; treats all kinds of wind disorders, hemoptysis, vomiting of blood, intestinal wind, and bloody dysentery. The skin is used to take advantage of its dispersing properties; the skin paste serves an astringent function.

Head:
The head, when decocted, treats leukorrhea. Also made into glue, it treats wind disorders, calms agitation, reduces swelling, and checks flowing sores.

Milk:
Milk is cold in nature, promotes urination, treats fright in children, alleviates thirst, and warms the stomach when prepared with bamboo and heat.

Urine:
Urine is neutral in nature, stops certain conditions, is salty, and also counters gu toxin and pain; used as an astringent.

Feces:
Feces treats heart colic, abdominal pain; the expressed juice is acrid; taken orally it relieves various pains.

Grease from the tail axle (tail-hub grease):
Primarily treats carbuncles; whether long-standing or new, it contains a small toxin.

Mule meat:
Mule meat from various localities should not be consumed freely; it is warm in nature and acrid in flavor; eating it carries some toxicity.

Fox's genital cap (foxes' yin cover):
Large nose, small tail, female genitalia, small testicles, slightly drowsy appearance; it is similar in form to a yellow dog but smaller.

Meat:
The meat has a disagreeable odor, is sweet in flavor, and contains a small toxin. It governs the five viscera, expels pathogenic qi, calms the spirit, supplements deficiency fatigue, treats gu toxin and scabies, and transforms food when eaten. When eaten raw as a minced dish, it is very warming and strengthening.

translation:
Dispelling Wind

Five Organs: Nature slightly cold; taste bitter; toxic. Mainly treats gu toxin (parasitic poison) and childhood fright-epilepsy. Burning the liver to ash treats wind conditions.

Gallbladder: Used to revive people. In cases of sudden collapse, administer raw; grind and pour in, wait for revival.

Intestines and Stomach: Nature benefits children. Treats fright-epilepsy and slight cold. Mainly treats malaria; also treats scabies and [related conditions].

Head and Tail: Burning is harmful. The male [otter], in the correct month, is used as a courier [remedy].

Lips: Cutting out [and using]; burning away foul odors. Treats epidemic illness, upward-rushing qi. The male [otter], taste sweet; those who say it treats chronic illness, stops worms, preserves for long periods; mainly treats [the above conditions].

Excrement: Burning it is good. In cases of epidemic foul qi from enclosed spaces, the male [otter] in the correct month is also used. Has [effect on] fatigue-illness, stops worms, main treatment; use fish as ritual offering.

Otter Liver: [For] epidemic contagion spreading from person to person; nature [cold]; treats consumption and wasting disease conditions through sequential transmission. Used with appropriate medicines to treat extreme fatigue.

Heavenly Gu Toxin: Treats strange scabies; among the five domestic animals — dogs and meat — all have [slightly cold nature]; only [the otter's] nature is warm; the medicine should be stopped if corpse-fatigue symptoms occur; the medicine treats extreme fatigue.

Second Month: Mainly benefits birthing [animals]; among the six domestic animals, the medicine is sometimes used; also has the property of reducing [conditions]; it must match this form to be effective; verified by [the source text].

translation:
Flesh — Gallbladder — Kidney — Bone — Marrow — Four Feet (Limbs) — Skin

[Flesh:] It is good for deficiency conditions. Its nature is neutral and non-toxic. It mainly treats bone-steaming fever; when decocted and consumed, it benefits the blood and vessels. It is suitable for women and children to eat regularly.

[Gallbladder:] Its nature is cold. It mainly treats water retention and bloating in the lower abdomen. When the hot swelling subsides, the qi and fluids are regulated. It benefits men and is good for the eyes. When administered as a decoction, it treats suppurating sores, swellings, and masses on the face.

[Kidney:] It mainly treats the eyes and improves vision. Combined with wine, taken with a slight increase in dose, it has been shown to be effective. Ancient formulas mention using it with flying rope hemp and ox bile. Tests show results, though not always verified. It treats carbuncles, hard nodes, and facial ulcers.

[Bone:] It mainly promotes marrow growth, which is difficult. The white layer is applied as a paste. It is hard to use medicinally.

[Marrow:] It reduces and treats swellings. It is applied as a paste. Taken with bone broth, it is beneficial.

[Four Feet:] The main fish bones are cooked and the broth drunk. The juice is boiled and applied.

[Skin:] It is used so that the skin of people, taken from the eel, day by day adorns and smooths the body. It repels dust and wind, so that not even road dust clings to it; it is said to be effective for the complexion.

translation:
Cat Meat
It is also called by other names. Its nature is balanced, taste sweet and pungent; it is said to be non-toxic. It is mainly used for long-standing water swelling and toxic conditions. Taken in sufficient quantity, it is extremely nourishing. Used to treat long-standing ringworm. Eaten regularly, it reduces abdominal bloating. Also known locally as "earth pig" or wild cat.

Fat and Grease (of Cat)
Eating it is a fine tonic. It nourishes muscles and flesh, making the body fat and full. The white meat with yellow broth made into a soup and eaten regularly achieves this.

Bladder
When dried and emptied, it is used mainly to draw in qi, check demonic influences, and treat childhood nutritional disorders (gan) and related conditions.

Badger Meat
Its fur is used to make fur garments. Sweet in taste; it primarily governs the viscera, invigorates the spirit, and treats many types of conditions including vacuity swellings (yong) in women. Its shape and coloring resemble a small fox. Used popularly to treat emaciation in children and to relieve swelling. Commonly called "mountain dog." Its flavor is mild.

Raccoon Dog (Hǒ) Meat
Its fur is also used similarly. Sweet in taste; it primarily governs the viscera, invigorates the spirit, and treats many types of conditions including vacuity swellings in women. Its shape and coloring resemble a small fox.

Fur Seal Kidney (Wǎnà Qí)
Its nature is greatly warming, taste salty; said to be non-toxic. It mainly treats the five strains and seven injuries, decline of kidney essence and weakness, depletion of kidney qi, and excessive sexual indulgence. It assists yang qi, relieves lumbar and kidney soreness, itching, weakness of the knees and bladder, and cold in the fox-cold pattern. Also known in Silla (ancient Korea) as "sea dog outer kidney." It is taken together with the testes to assist [the yang].

[Right column, main text - properties of animal medicines:]

The membrane [of the kidney region] has red-purple color. Its skin above naturally has flesh, yellow fur, three covers sharing one cavity. One takes its flesh at the proper time, scrapes the branches and uses them through the gate.

The external kidney is dried for a hundred days, placed in a dense pattern in the middle, constantly moistened through the membrane, finely scraped of its flesh, pounded alone with the branches for use.

[One] must dry it in shade for a hundred days. Above there are red-purple fine spots. Place over fire twice until fragrant. Finely scrape the flesh and pound alone for use.

Grind it until like fire burning; remove the true fur. Those with slight [spotting] soak in wine for one day, heat over a gentle dog-fire, alternately roast until fragrant.

The flesh has a pungent flavor and can be eaten.
The color — it can cry out; all its fur becomes sparse.
Below the wolf's throat hangs a flap of flesh; it is good at looking back [over its shoulder] swiftly.

Prognosis/Symptoms (候):
Regarding wolf tail — yellow-black in color, long and large. Warriors take it and hang it [from their belts]. It can transform a person's form to resemble a marten.
At eight hundred years [of age] — three hundred years — it then becomes capable of transformation.

translation:
Musk Rat (囊鼠): Nature is slightly cold. Mainly treats cold-damage disorders and fatigue relapse. Also treats childhood diseases.

Mole (鼴鼠): Treats carbuncles and abscesses in both yin and yang regions, blood vessel blockages that form into carbuncles and abscesses and pox, and various fistulas. Eating mole can disperse carbuncles, abscesses, and scabies. Another name is yanshu. Its form resembles a snake-fish. Its temperament and flavor are unusual; it carries toxicity. Often black in color, it commonly burrows through cultivated earth, moving with its nose pointed forward, strong legs, and a short mouth. It has extremely short legs but can be caught by children.

Field Mouse (鼷鼠): Nature is slightly warm. Primarily aids in easy delivery during pregnancy. The field mouse is dark in appearance, resembling the current season. It can fly far like a bat and is as large as a magpie-mouse in the dark. It produces gu-worm infestations and parasites naturally.

Worn Drum Skin (敗鼓皮): Bitter in taste. Used for conditions where the skin is penetrated and broken, applied to ill persons. Taking it orally prevents gu-toxin infestation. Used to neutralize named poisons and gu-toxins; roast and bake until done.

Marten (貂鼠): Can penetrate through tight spaces and break skin; good quality specimens are used. Marten ash mixed with wine is taken medicinally. Treats atrophy syndrome, functions similarly to treating rushing piglet qi surging upward; roast to ash, take over long period.

Yellow Rat (黃鼠): Found in winter. Also known as the four-footed rat. Effective for multiple conditions. The four-legged wolf-rat. Primarily reduces and disperses conditions. Burn to ash for administration; long-term use is not suitable in excess.
